display_name: Anthropic Claude Code (Agent tool, SendMessage, ListAgents, TaskStop)

isolated.notes: Agent-tool subagents start without the parent conversation; pass the full handoff in prompt.

interrupt_turn.reason: No turn-only interrupt; TaskStop stops the agent task.

close.notes: Observed 2026-09-15: stopping an agent also ends the shell command it was running, and the stop arrives as a task notification with status killed. A stopped agent is not terminal; resume_closed still revives it.

resume_closed.notes: Observed 2026-09-15: a completed agent and an agent stopped through close both resume from their own transcript and keep their original instructions.

turn_steer.reason: SendMessage queues for the next tool round only.

usage_read.reason: No usage method exposed to the model.

task_create.reason: Agent subagents run inside this session and cannot be relied on to host a four-role delivery in their own worktree. The user starts a separate session in a new worktree with the CREATE_TASK prompt and reports its name and paths.

task_wait.notes: One-shot idle notice from a session on this machine; re-subscribe after each notice. The tool schema still lists message as required with an empty default, so send an empty message for a pure subscription.

wake_schedule.notes: Session-only, fires only while idle, recurring jobs expire after 7 days.

project_discover.reason: The session working directory is the project; confirm it with git rev-parse --show-toplevel.
